fields.label: Additional Experiments
fields.help: List of experiments that should be used by the job.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Enable Streaming Engine
fields.help: Indicates if the job should use the streaming engine feature.

fields.label: KMS Key Name
fields.help: The name for the Cloud KMS key for the job.

fields.label: Machine Type
fields.help: The machine type to use for the job.

fields.label: Max Workers
fields.help: The number of workers permitted to work on the job.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A unique name for the resource, required by Dataflow.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The network to which VMs will be assigned.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The project in which the resource belongs.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: The region in which the created job should run.

fields.label: Service Account Email
fields.help: The Service Account email used to create the job.

fields.label: Skip Wait On Job Termination
fields.help: If true, treat DRAINING and CANCELLING as terminal job states and do not wait for further changes before removing from terraform state and moving on.

fields.label: Subnetwork
fields.help: The subnetwork to which VMs will be assigned.

fields.label: Temp Gcs Location
fields.help: A writeable location on Google Cloud Storage for the Dataflow job to dump its temporary data.

fields.label: Template Gcs Path
fields.help: The Google Cloud Storage path to the Dataflow job template.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: The zone in which the created job should run.
